messages:
Aisha Patel: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands on customer wins & losses. I'm collecting clarifying Qs and action items for leadership. Please drop quick asks and any evidence (links/screenshots) we should include.
Miguel Santos: Quick Q — when we said "lost due to reliability", do we have SLA breach counts vs. perception? need numbers for sales deck.
Claire Nguyen: +1. Also curious which models/configs customers were on when they hit issues. Any mapping from customer -> model version?
Ethan Zhang: We have partial mapping in the internal telemetry: https://intra.redwood/models/rollout-mapping (need access). Will collate by EOD.
Priya Rao: For wins: can we surface product hooks customers actually used (streaming vs batch vs embeddings)? I can pull from console events.
Samir Reddy: Sales follow-up — if we lost on pricing, do we have the competitive comparative we showed in slide 7? want to know the specific delta customers cited.
Aisha Patel: Good — leadership asked for a short list: 1) top 3 reasons we lost, 2) top 3 asks customers consistently request, 3) one high-impact roadmap ask we can commit to. Keep replies terse.
Miguel Santos: Top loss reasons (field): reliability incidents, non-smooth private deployment onboarding, pricing/perceived unit cost. I'll validate counts with support.
Claire Nguyen: Top asks from product signals: better private deploy docs, VPC networking templates, improved SDK retry defaults.
Ethan Zhang: I'll attach a small snippet for onboarding pain:```
errors: ["kvcache-mismatch","timeout-attach"]
steps: ["download model","init runtime","register instance"]
```Customers hit that during on-prem installs.
Priya Rao: Evidence: 3 recent deals flagged the lack of a single-script installer. I can share redacted logs with eng.
Samir Reddy: Sales asks: trial credits for Dedicated, clearer burst pricing, and a sandbox private deployment offering for POCs.
Aisha Patel: Leadership Q: which of these are product changes vs. documentation/training? Please tag with PROD vs DOC.
Miguel Santos: PROD: reliability fixes, private-deploy automation. DOC: onboarding guides, SDK examples. Pricing: go-to-market decision.
Claire Nguyen: PROD: add VPC template + installer. DOC: step-by-step migration guide.
Ethan Zhang: PROD/DOC note: some reliability issues are config defaults — quick win is to change default retry backoff & add a KB article.
Priya Rao: Actionable asks I'm committing to: compile top 10 customer quotes (redacted), link to incidents, and a short README for field with POC steps — by Thu.
Samir Reddy: I can coordinate a follow-up customer panel for QA with 6 leads next week. want an outcome doc and 3 targeted asks for each.
dennis-bot: Document updated: /docs/all-hands/customer-retro-2005 (edited by Aisha Patel)
Aisha Patel: Thanks — if you're owning an item, drop "OWNED by <name>" here. I'll assemble and send to leadership tomorrow afternoon. :sparkles:
Miguel Santos: OWNED by Miguel — counts for reliability and mapping to model versions.
Claire Nguyen: OWNED by Claire — VPC templates and migration guide.
Ethan Zhang: OWNED by Ethan — telemetry extract + sample error snippets.
Priya Rao: OWNED by Priya — client quotes + field README.
Samir Reddy: OWNED by Samir — customer panel logistics.
Aisha Patel: Great — please add links to any artifacts as you update. If anyone has short wins we can ship in a week, flag them here with ETA.
Priya Rao: small win: ship a CLI installer script (ETA 6 business days) — I'll post PR link when ready.
Ethan Zhang: small win: tweak SDK default retry (ETA 2 days) — will open PR.
Claire Nguyen: noted. I'll prioritize docs edits after PRs land.
Aisha Patel: Perfect. Closing loop — I'll send the leadership summary by 3pm tomorrow. Thanks team. :pray:
